from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """A single legal document with its title and cause of action."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the document, e.g., '《判决文书1》'")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action (案由) stated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregated extraction results for the document batch."""
    documents: list[Document]
